hero.title: Lymphatic drainage in Lyon
hero.text: The word “drainage” covers two very different practices. Which one is right for you?

wellness.title: I want to feel lighter
wellness.text: Drainage, Body Sculpting and Miracle Face, Renata França method. No prescription needed, except during pregnancy.

medical.title: I need drainage for my health
medical.text: After surgery, lipedema, heavy legs, after cancer treatment… Therapeutic drainage adapted to your tissues, on prescription.

renata.title: Renata França treatments
renata.text: Rhythmic, enveloping treatments for a feeling of lightness and a sculpting effect. At the Lyon 1 and Lyon 5 practices.

drainage.title: Drainage
drainage.text: The drainage that feels good and that you can feel. With a few precise, rhythmic movements, your body regains a pleasant feeling of lightness.

remodelage.title: Body Sculpting
remodelage.text: The treatment that complements drainage. Rhythmic and deep, it gives a sculpting effect and skin that feels smoother to the touch.

miracleFace.title: Miracle Face
miracleFace.text: A rhythmic, enveloping facial treatment for a feeling of freshness and a rested look.

pregnancy.title: During pregnancy and after giving birth

pregnant.title: You are pregnant
pregnant.text: Heavy legs, a feeling of swelling: Renata França drainage can bring you a real feeling of lightness during your pregnancy. It is carried out on prescription.

newMother.title: You are a new mother
newMother.text: After giving birth, Renata França drainage helps you regain a feeling of lightness in your legs and belly, and gives you a real moment for yourself.
newMother.linkIntro: To rebuild your core and get back to sport, also discover

renata.note: A wellness treatment, outside a medical setting, not reimbursed. During pregnancy or if you have a medical condition, a prescription is required.

comparison.title: Therapeutic or wellness: the difference
comparison.text: After an operation, drainage must be adapted to the condition of your tissues and to your surgeon's instructions: **it is not a wellness session**.

rows.label: For whom
rows.therapeutic: Surgery (cosmetic, reconstructive, varicose veins), lipedema, after cancer treatment, heavy legs
rows.renata: Anyone who wants to feel lighter, including during pregnancy (on prescription) and after giving birth

rows.label: Goal
rows.therapeutic: Reduce swelling, prevent fibrosis, support healing

rows.label: Technique
rows.therapeutic: Adapted to the condition of the tissues and the surgeon's instructions
rows.renata: Rhythm and pressure specific to the method

rows.label: Prescription
rows.renata: No, except during pregnancy or if you have a medical condition

rows.label: Reimbursement
rows.therapeutic: Very rarely, based on the angiologist's diagnosis ([see above])

surgery.title: Cosmetic or reconstructive surgery
paragraphs: Liposuction, tummy tuck, facelift, breast surgery… Manual drainage adapted to your tissues, combined if needed with taping, scar work and gentle rehabilitation, in coordination with your surgeon.

lipedema.title: Lipedema
paragraphs: A chronic disease of the fatty tissue, often mistaken for weight gain: disproportionate fat, mainly on the legs, tender to the touch, with a tendency to bruise.
Manual drainage is a cornerstone of treatment, whether as conservative therapy or in preparation for liposuction. Diagnosed or suspected: let's talk about it at the assessment.

oncology.title: After cancer treatment
paragraphs: After surgery or treatment for cancer, for example after lymph node removal, drainage helps prevent and manage lymphedema, in coordination with your medical team.

varicose.title: After varicose vein surgery
paragraphs: To limit swelling and support your legs' recovery after the operation, following your vascular surgeon's instructions.

heavyLegs.title: Heavy legs
paragraphs: Heavy or swollen legs at the end of the day, venous insufficiency: the assessment helps take stock and adapt the treatment.
heavyLegs.link: Renata França drainage may also suit you.

reimbursement.title: Is drainage reimbursed?
reimbursement.p1: Very rarely, **even with a prescription**. The French national health insurance (Assurance Maladie) only covers it in a few cases:
reimbursement.p2: This is determined by the angiologist's written diagnosis and my assessment. In these cases, treatment takes place in Lyon 5. In all other cases, sessions are charged at the prices below.

prices.title: Therapeutic drainage prices
prices.payment: Payment: cash, cheque, bank transfer, Wero.

hesitate.title: Not sure?

items.text: An assessment to choose the technique suited to your tissues and the operation.

items.title: You have had surgery
items.text: An assessment, then adapted post-operative drainage techniques.

items.title: You have lipedema
items.text: Diagnosed or suspected: start with an assessment.

items.text: Renata França drainage, with a legs option adapted to pregnancy.

hesitate.p1: If in doubt, the assessment lets us take stock and decide together.
